observation: Decoded start, midpoint and final previews show the same initial tilted field, later flow reversals and similar evolving column-depth traces. Shared legends are clear of the data; zero-speed arrows are hidden; units, times and both fixed color scales are readable. Numerical plots retain the two OpenFOAM bound misses and the accepted pressure-correction repeat.
limitations: Representative visual review; every MP4 and GIF frame was separately decoded and compared numerically with its source PNG. Physical validation and mesh/time independence remain open.
